what: Titles and one-line copy are split into letters, and each letter turns on in .5s with a fixed scattered delay (section title .03~.3s on a 30-letter cycle, wide type .03~.47s on a 25-letter cycle). It looks random but follows the same order every time it opens. With tint on, each letter tints from ink to the accent color over .3s, starting .2s later (the section title turns red as it appears)

options.start: ‹load› (default, attaches then waits for delay) · ‹view› (once, when it enters the screen and the delay has also passed)
options.delay: Wait before turning on (ms), default 0 — original one-line text 500, intro large title 200·400, detail first section title 600
options.look: If ”wide”, the one-line copy delay table (.03~.47s), otherwise the section title delay table (.03~.3s)
options.tint: If 1, it turns on and the text color tints to --kf-accent
options.margin: start: when view, IntersectionObserver rootMargin, default 0px
options.--fx-dur · --fx-tint-dur · --fx-tint-lag: Set with CSS variables: on length (.5s), tint length (.3s), tint delay (.2s)

use: Who We Are
note: The original is a css table with transition-delay set on each letter span’s nth-child. The part puts the same table into --fx-d in letter order (counting continues in document order even across multiple lines and inner tags)

from.where: shared.js section title .tc-title (original random-show-wrap + invation-sectiontitle — opacity .5s, color .3s delayed by +.2s, react-intersection-observer threshold 0 once) · index.html hero one-line copy .tc-copy (original copy-reveal — is-shown after 500ms, each glyph .03~.47s) · about.html big title (delay 200·400) · detail.html first section title (delay 600)
